newsitem.title: USA: FirstFed Bancshares files conversion papers.
newsitem.headline: FirstFed Bancshares files conversion papers.

text.p: FirstFed Bancshares Inc said Tuesday it has applied to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to covert its charter to that of a national bank.
FirstFed is a thrift holding company that owns First Federal Bank, a nationally chartered savings bank, with consolidated assets of $552.6 million.

The company said the application also seeks to change its name to CoVest Bancshares Inc and the name of the bank to CoVest Banc N.A., effective on or about June 2. FirstFed said its stock symbol is also expected to change on June 2 to COVB.
FirstFed's shares closed up 1/2 Tuesday at 17-1/2.
